Spatial prediction
The shore route remains at 0 m and has no middle-ravine
escape. The Boat Shed corner and Salt Store form a 6
m-deep lower-harbor bend before B. L can stop before the
final corner while F retains the paid return to Shore Toe.
Follower / support
F sees L in the harbor approach but loses immediate site
support when L rounds the M10 corner. The retreat is
through the same ground route; a middle teammate can
relieve it by threatening S5.
Opponent / retreat
A B defender can push the bend but leaves a site-facing
position and must account for the east descents. Salt
Store blocks an automatic upper reserve view into the
entire harbor; exact S5 grade exposures remain to capture.
